tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'o skol gyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas cho 'phrul bstan tshul mdo tsam bshad pa dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rigs can gsum gyi snang ngor thub dbang dang / /sa bcu rgyud ldan dbus su longs spyod rdzogs/ /bdag sogs don du bshes gnyen chen po'i skur/ /legs bstan mus pa rje la gus btud nas/ /'o skol ston pa zas gtsang sras po yis/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ /legs bshad dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya 'di/ /'chad par 'gyur gyi dpyod ldan dga' bas nyon/ de la 'dir cho 'phrul gyi dus spyir bstan pa dang / cho 'phrul bstan tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rta zla'i yar tshes bco lnga ni/ /lung rtogs bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshar bcad pa'i/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i dus yin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ rta pa'i zla ba'i yar tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar ni bdud dang mu stegs can la sogs pa cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas tshar bcad pa cho 'phrul chen po'i dus chen dag tu gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde mdzangs blun las/ cho 'phrul gyi dus chen 'di dag la/ gleng gzhi/ 'khor bsdus tshul/ cho 'phrul bstan tshul/ de ltar 'byung pa'i rgyu mtshan bzhi'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad cing / 'dir cho 'phrul bstan tshul mdo tsam tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas bshad pa ni/ dgun zla tha chung tshes gcig la/ /gnyan yod gsal rgyal mchod pa'i tshe/ /tshems shing sa la btsugs ma thag /rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga rnams/ /rin chen bdun gyi rang bzhin can/ /dpag tshad lnga brgya'i rgya khyon can/ /lo 'dab me tog yid 'ong zhing / /bre lnga shong ba'i 'bras bu chags/ /de yi kha tog 'od zer gyis/ /nyi ma zla ba zil gnon cing / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bsung las/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog par sprul/ /tshes gnyis u tra ya nas mchod/

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i g.yas dang g.yon/ /nags tshal sna tshogs rab brgyan cing / /mthong mdzes ri gnyis sprul pa'i rtser/ /ro brgya dang ldan 'jam zhing mngar/ /'bras bus mi rnams yid bzhin tshims/ /'jam mngar mnyen pa'i rtswa mchog gis/ /byol song tshims shing bde skyid sprul/ /tshes gsum shun rtsin rgyal pos mchod/ /zhal bshal 'thor 'thung dor ba las/ /khor yug dpag tshad nyis brgya la/ /rin chen rgyan gyis rab spras pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu mchog /shing rta 'phang lo tshad ldan pa/ /sna tshogs padmo 'od zer gyis/ rnam pa kun tu snang ba sprul/ /tshes bzhi ind+ra bha mas mchod/ /rdzing bu de yi ngos bzhi nas/ /yur chen brgyad brgyad 'khor ba las/ /ngo mtshar sgra skad 'di ltar byung / /dbang stobs byang chub 'phags lam brgyad/ /rnam thar gsum dang mngon shes drug /phar phyin drug dang tshad med sogs/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa sprul/ /tshes lnga tshangs sbyin rgyal pos mchod/ /ston pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor las/ /gser gyi mdog can 'od 'phros pas/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams kun gsal/ /'od des reg pa'i sems can rnams/ /dug gsum sgrib pa lnga bral te/ /lus sems bde bas tshims pa dang / /yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pa sprul/ /tshes drug li tsa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /ston pa 'khor rnams thams cad kyis/ /gcig bsam gcig gis shes gyur te/ /so so'i dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las 'bras phan tshun mngon gyur nas/ /las 'bras yid ches dad pa yis/ /ston pa'i yon tan rjod byed cing / /dge tshogs rgya chen bsgrubs par sprul/ /tshes bdun shāka rigs rnams kyis mchod/ /ston pa'i 'khor rnams so sor nas/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /rin chen sna bdun bu stong ldan/ /rgyal phran blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /kun la mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung spro ba skyes/

/chos kyi don la sbyar ba sprul/ /ston drug cho 'phrul bstan sems kyang / /sems khong chud de yan lag rengs/ /kha rnams 'thams shing cho 'phrul ni/ /cung zad ston pa'i mthu med gyur/ /tshes brgyad lha dbang spyan drangs te/ /g.yas g.yon tshangs dang brgya byin mchod/ /seng khri phyag gis mnan pa las/ /'ur zhing brjid pa'i sgra chen dang / /khro zhing rab tu gtum pa yis/ /srin po lnga yi tshogs sprul te/ /ston drug khri bshig sdigs par byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po phyag rdor gyis/ /me phung 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bskrad/ /kha cig skyengs te chu la mchongs/ /stong phrag gcig dang dgu khri ni/ /ston la skyabs zhus rab byung gsol/ /legs par 'ongs so bka' stsal pas/ /skra dang kha spu rang lhung ste/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge slong gyur/ /chos bstan zag zad sgrib bral mdzad/ /tshes dgu tshangs pa'i rgyal pos mchod/ /'od zer 'phros pa'i sku lus kyis/ /tshangs pa'i bar du khyab mdzad nas/ /gsung gis 'gro rnams grol bar mdzad/ /tshes bcu rgyal chen sde bzhis mchod/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i sku lus kyis/ /srid rtse'i bar du khyab mdzad nas/ /gsung gis 'gro la chos ston mdzad/ /bcu gcig mgon med zas sbyin mchod/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs bzhin du/ /sku lus mi snang 'od zer gyis/ /stong gsum khyab cing chos ston mdzad/ /bcu gnyis khyim bdag tsi tas mchod/ /stong gsum 'od kyis khyab mdzad cing / /'od des reg pa'i sems can rnams/ /skyon bral yon tan ldan par mdzad/ /bcu gsum bdud kyi rgyal pos mchod/ /sku yi lte ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /'od zer gnyis byung 'dom bdun 'phags/ /de steng yid 'ong padma la/ /sprul sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa bzhugs/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'od zer gnyis gnyis 'dom bdun 'phags/ /de steng yid 'ong padma la/ /sprul sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa bzhugs/

/de la 'od zer padma dang / /sprul sku gcig la gnyis 'phros pas/ /brgyad dang bcu drug so gnyis la/ /drug bcu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa/ /stong gsum bar du khyab pa ni/ /'khor rnams kun la mngon gyur te/ /ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long g.yos/ /bcu bzhi ston pa 'khor bcas la/ /u tra ya nas me tog gtor/ /gtor ba'i me tog sna tshogs ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu la sogs pa/ /rin chen du mas legs spras pa/ /brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi/ /grangs ldan rin chen shing rtar gyur/ /mtho khyad tshangs pa'i bar du 'phags/ /rin chen shing rta re re'i steng / /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas re re bzhugs/ /stong gsum 'od kyis khyab mdzad nas/ /chos kyi rtogs pa 'phel bar mdzad/ /bco lnga gzugs can snying pos mchod/ /zos na lus sems bde ba 'dren/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas kyis/ /snod rnams ma lus yongs su gang / /phyag gis sa la bsnun ma thag /sems can dmyal khams bco brgyad ni/ /tshad med sdug bsngal gyis gzir zhing / /bdag gis sngon sdig ci zhig byas/ /'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong ngo zhes/ /smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa ni/ /kun la mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ /dngangs skrag 'dar zhing ba spu g.yo/ /de la rgyal bas chos bstan pas/ /la la shi 'phos lha ru skyes/ /la la byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /'ga' zhig dgra bcom mngon byas so/ /de ltar nyin zhag bco lnga la/ /thub dbang cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshul/ /legs bshad dad pa'i snye ma 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bzhi thog bla brang yang rtse yi/ /tshe 'dzin g.yab tu myur bar bris/ /'di sbyar dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /tshe ring nad med don kun 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can bgrod shog /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i ming can gyis bgyis so/

/'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// //kā lya na wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas cho 'phrul bstan tshul mdo tsam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
